query: My PC is slow and the disk is almost full. Find what I can remove and ask me before cleaning anything.
expected_behavior: Starts with a read-only PowerShell assessment and changes nothing before approval
Reports findings in the four tiers (startup, bloatware, review item by item, junk) with size and risk per item
Plans a restore point and reversible changes (disable before uninstall) for the approved sections

query: Docker is using 80 GB. Can I just delete the vhdx file?
expected_behavior: Warns that deleting the disk image destroys images, containers, and volumes
Recommends docker system df and prune first, then wsl --shutdown and compacting the vhdx
Marks version-specific paths with [verify] instead of stating one path as fact

query: Should I uninstall all these Visual C++ Redistributables and run a registry cleaner to speed things up?
expected_behavior: Advises keeping the redistributables and explains they are shared dependencies
Recommends against registry cleaners and suggests built-in alternatives
Keeps the answer short since this is a quick question
